notes: Every file is pinned by SHA-256. The xlsx files are committed byte-identical under tests/fixtures/usgs_water_use/<source_key>.xlsx.
The 2010 report exists only as a PDF. Its island-wide values are a manual transcription bound to the PDF's SHA-256; the PDF is never parsed and never committed.
retrieved_utc is the moment the pinned bytes were downloaded, not the moment a run re-read them.
